g.text: CHILD: PLAY
teddy demos, one
question, honest!
TEEN: RESPECT
privacy + straight
talk + choices!
ELDER: PACE
slow + loud-clear +
one at a time!
DEAF: FACE + WRITE
light + lips + paper
+ interpreter!
BLIND: NARRATE
announce + describe +
guide don't grab!
CHILDREN: play IS language — teddy gets the injection first! One question, concrete
words ("a small ouch like an ant bite"), HONEST always ("this will hurt a little" — lies
destroy all future trust!), choices ("left arm or right?"), parents as partners (triangulate:
child + parent + nurse!). Never threaten ("injection if you cry!" — cruelty!).
TEENS: privacy ("shall mum step out?") + straight talk (no babying, no preaching!) +
choices + confidentiality explained ("I'll keep… except danger…"). Respect = adherence.
ELDERS (GER!): slow pace + loud-CLEAR (not shouting!) + ONE question + written keywords +
hearing aids IN + glasses ON + no elderspeak ("sweetie" insults!). Talk TO them, not past
them to relatives. Dementia: short + calm + one-step + validate feelings (GER M5!).
DEAF/HARD-HEARING: face + light on YOUR face + slow + write keywords + diagrams + trained
interpreter for big news; NEVER shout (distorts!) or speak to the companion instead.
BLIND/LOW-VISION: announce entry/exit ("I'm Ama, leaving now") + narrate actions ("I'm
taking your BP — cuff on your arm") + guide by elbow-offer, never grab + orient room +
large-print/audio instructions.
APHASIA/STROKE: yes-no + pictures + patience + celebrate tries (ANP/GER!). Confusion:
reorient kindly, short sentences, family voices calm (GER M5!).
LINKS: GER M3/M5 elders + dementia · NUT M3 IYCF · PRO-I consent capacity.
MANTRA: "play with children, pace with elders, face the deaf, narrate the blind."
